rows.name: PAUSE_LEN_NS

problems.statement: A negative number becomes a very large unsigned number.
problems.code_says: `tpause_ns` is `uint64_t`. `std::stoi` returns `int`, so `-1` becomes 2^64 - 1. The check `REQUIRE(tpause_ns >= 0)` can never fail for an unsigned value. The present text gives no number.

problems.statement: `h/system/mwaitx.hpp` describes that deadline as a target value of the time-stamp counter (TSC), not a length.
problems.code_says: The sentence reports a source comment. The code shows the behavior: `intel_tpause(hint, tsc_deadline)` loads the value into EDX:EAX of the `tpause` instruction, which is the TSC deadline of that instruction.

problems.statement: Text that does not start with a number makes `std::stoi` throw an exception.
problems.code_says: True, but the outcome is missing. The call sits in the body of the Catch2 test case, so the test case fails. An empty value also throws, which differs from unset (500 nanoseconds).

problems.statement: a test loop that polls a flag and does not sleep
problems.code_says: House rule 9 and the validator forbid the word outside code. The polled object is `std::atomic<bool> flag`, a variable that both threads share.

cells.Values and default: Integer number of nanoseconds, parsed with `std::stoi`. Text that does not start with a number makes `std::stoi` throw an exception. The test case then fails. Unset: 500 nanoseconds. Empty: `std::stoi` throws an exception.
cells.Effect: Sets the wait length that the main thread of the spin-wait benchmark (a test loop that polls a shared variable and does not sleep) gives to the CPU instruction `tpause`. The worker thread always uses 500 nanoseconds. Read only when `PAUSE_TYPE` is `tpause`. The test does not reject a negative number. It stores the value as an unsigned 64-bit number. `-1` becomes 2^64 - 1 nanoseconds. The test converts the length to CPU cycles and passes it as the `tsc_deadline` argument of `intel_tpause`. `tpause` treats that argument as a target value of the time-stamp counter (TSC), not as a length.
